criteria.description: Both --version aliases emit exactly one copyable line even when the terminal is narrower than the output
criteria.evidence: tests/specify_cli/cli/commands/test_version_output.py::test_version_output_is_one_copyable_version_line and ::test_version_output_keeps_long_custom_label_on_one_line; focused acceptance command passed 22 tests
criteria.notes: Covers --version and -v at COLUMNS=10/20, including a long custom distribution version_label.

criteria.description: Version output contains no large banner or decorative cat art
criteria.evidence: tests/specify_cli/cli/commands/test_version_output.py::test_version_output_does_not_render_large_banner and tests/runtime/test_banner_visibility.py::test_version_callback_does_not_render_banner; focused acceptance command passed 22 tests
criteria.notes: The version callback no longer imports or invokes show_banner.

criteria.description: Version output preserves the resolved distribution identity and current package version
criteria.evidence: tests/specify_cli/cli/commands/test_version_output.py and tests/core/test_resolve_cli_package_name.py::test_version_callback_label_uses_resolved_name; focused acceptance command passed 22 tests
criteria.notes: The DistributionProfile version_label remains authoritative, falling back to package_name.

criteria.description: No retained decoration competes with or follows the version line
criteria.evidence: Exact-output assertions in tests/specify_cli/cli/commands/test_version_output.py prove the sole output is the distribution-aware version line; focused acceptance command passed 22 tests
criteria.notes: The implementation chose the permitted no-decoration alternative.
